ExpeditionProfile.title: ExpeditionProfile
ExpeditionProfile.description: Custom profile settings (nickname, character avatar, or custom photo) for one of the 4 expedition members.

memberId.description: Unique member identifier (e.g. kakao_hyunwoo_mom, kakao_sehyun_mom, kakao_hyunwoo, kakao_sehyun)

nickname.description: Custom display nickname chosen by the member (1 to 40 chars)

defaultNickname.description: Original default role name (현우맘, 세현맘, 현우, 세현)

avatarEmoji.description: Emoji badge associated with the selected avatar

profileImageUrl.description: Optional custom uploaded photo data URL or image URL

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update

StampMission.title: StampMission
StampMission.description: Daily expedition stamp mission and mom praise badge item shared in real time across both families.

missionId.description: Unique mission ID (1 to 64 alphanumeric, underscore, or hyphen chars)

dayNumber.description: Day number from 0 to 6 (0 for general mom praise badges, 1-6 for Day 1 to Day 6)

title.description: Mission title or praise achievement title (1 to 80 chars)

placeTag.description: Location or category label (1 to 40 chars)

rewardPoint.description: Stamp points awarded upon completion (1 to 5)

hyunwooStamped.description: Whether Hyunwoo has earned this stamp (granted by Hyunwoo Mom)

sehyunStamped.description: Whether Sehyun has earned this stamp (granted by Sehyun Mom)

hyunwooRequested.description: Whether Hyunwoo has requested a stamp from Hyunwoo Mom

sehyunRequested.description: Whether Sehyun has requested a stamp from Sehyun Mom

praiseNote.description: Optional short praise comment from moms (0 to 120 chars)

updatedBy.description: Display nickname of the member who last updated the stamp or mission (1 to 40 chars)

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update

/profiles/{memberId}.description: Stores shared expedition member profiles indexed by memberId

/stampMissions/{missionId}.description: Stores daily stamp missions and praise badges for the Tokyo expedition
